# Bilibili / 哔哩哔哩

> A leading Chinese video sharing and content community covering anime, gaming, technology, lifestyle, and live streaming.
> 中国领先的视频分享与内容社区，覆盖动画、游戏、科技、生活、直播等多元内容。

Bilibili (also known as B站) is one of China's largest online video and content platforms, with hundreds of millions of monthly active users. Originating from anime, comic, and game (ACG) culture, it has expanded into a full-spectrum community where creators (known as UP主) publish long-form videos, livestream content, and engage with viewers through danmaku (real-time scrolling comments), bullet chat, and interactive features.

哔哩哔哩（简称 B 站）是中国大型在线视频内容平台之一，月活用户达数亿。最初源于 ACG（动画、漫画、游戏）文化，现已发展为覆盖泛娱乐、知识、生活方式的综合内容社区。创作者（即"UP 主"）通过长视频、直播以及弹幕等独有交互形式与用户深度连接。

## Core information / 核心信息

- [About Us / 关于我们](https://www.bilibili.com/blackboard/aboutUs.html): Company overview, mission, and brand introduction. / 公司简介、使命与品牌介绍。
- [Investor Relations / 投资者关系](https://ir.bilibili.com/): Financial reports and corporate disclosures. / 财报与公司披露信息。

## Main products / 主要产品线

- [Video / 视频](https://www.bilibili.com/): User-generated and professionally produced long-form videos across all categories. / 全品类的 UGC 与 PGC 长视频。
- [Anime (Bangumi) / 番剧](https://www.bilibili.com/anime/): Licensed Japanese and international anime series. / 正版日本及海外动画番剧。
- [Chinese Animation / 国创](https://www.bilibili.com/guochuang/): Original Chinese-produced animation. / 中国原创动画作品。
- [Documentary / 纪录片](https://www.bilibili.com/documentary/): Licensed and self-produced documentaries. / 正版及自制纪录片。
- [Movie / 电影](https://www.bilibili.com/movie/): Licensed films catalog. / 正版电影库。
- [TV Series / 电视剧](https://www.bilibili.com/tv/): Licensed TV series catalog. / 正版剧集库。
- [Variety / 综艺](https://www.bilibili.com/variety/): Variety shows. / 综艺节目。
- [Live Streaming / 直播](https://live.bilibili.com/): Real-time live streaming across gaming, entertainment, virtual idols, and more. / 游戏、娱乐、虚拟主播等实时直播内容。
- [Manga / 漫画](https://manga.bilibili.com/): Licensed and original digital manga and comics. / 正版及原创数字漫画。
- [Bilibili Game / 游戏中心](https://game.bilibili.com/): Game distribution, news, and community for licensed and self-published titles. / 游戏发行、资讯与社区，覆盖代理与自研游戏。
- [Cheese / 课堂](https://www.bilibili.com/cheese/): Paid knowledge and online courses. / 付费知识与在线课程。
- [Hui Yuan Gou / 会员购](https://show.bilibili.com/): Ticketing for events, exhibitions, performances, and ACG merchandise. / 演出票务、展览以及 ACG 周边商城。
- [Mall / 周边商城](https://mall.bilibili.com/): Official merchandise and ACG-licensed goods. / 官方周边及 ACG 授权商品。

## Content channels / 内容分区

- [Animation / 动画](https://www.bilibili.com/c/douga/): Fan animation, anime editing, cosplay, commentary, VTubers. / 同人动画、动漫剪辑、cosplay、动漫评论、虚拟 UP 主。
- [Gaming / 游戏](https://www.bilibili.com/c/game/): Gameplay, walkthroughs, esports across RPG, MOBA, FPS, mobile. / RPG、MOBA、射击、手游等实况、攻略与电竞。
- [Kichiku / 鬼畜](https://www.bilibili.com/c/kichiku/): Kichiku remixes, YTPMV/音MAD, manual VOCALOID — a signature Bilibili genre. / 鬼畜调教、鬼畜剧场、人力 VOCALOID、音 MAD，B 站标志性内容。
- [Music / 音乐](https://www.bilibili.com/c/music/): Original music, MV, covers, performance, VOCALOID. / 原创音乐、MV、翻唱、演奏、VOCALOID。
- [Dance / 舞蹈](https://www.bilibili.com/c/dance/): Otaku dance, street dance, traditional and idol dance, tutorials. / 宅舞、街舞、国风舞蹈、明星舞蹈、舞蹈教学。
- [Film & TV / 影视](https://www.bilibili.com/c/cinephile/): Film commentary, editing, news, short films, reactions. / 影视解读、剪辑、资讯、短剧短片、reaction。
- [Entertainment / 娱乐](https://www.bilibili.com/c/ent/): Celebrity content, entertainment news, variety clips. / 娱乐评论、明星剪辑、娱乐资讯、综艺正片。
- [Knowledge / 知识](https://www.bilibili.com/c/knowledge/): Science, humanities, business, career, social observation. / 科学科普、人文历史、商业财经、职场、社会观察。
- [Tech & Digital / 科技数码](https://www.bilibili.com/c/tech/): Computers, phones, photography, gadgets, DIY hardware. / 电脑、手机、摄影摄像、工程机械、自制设备。
- [Information / 资讯](https://www.bilibili.com/c/information/): Current affairs, overseas, social and general news. / 时政、海外、社会、综合资讯。
- [Food / 美食](https://www.bilibili.com/c/food/): Cooking, food tours, reviews, food records. / 美食制作、探店、测评、记录。
- [Short Skits / 小剧场](https://www.bilibili.com/c/shortplay/): Scripted plots, language comedy, mini variety, street interviews. / 剧情演绎、语言类小剧场、UP 主小综艺、街头采访。
- [Auto / 汽车](https://www.bilibili.com/c/car/): Car reviews, culture, automotive life and tech. / 汽车测评、文化、生活、技术。
- [Fashion & Beauty / 时尚美妆](https://www.bilibili.com/c/fashion/): Makeup, skincare, outfits, accessories, fashion commentary. / 美妆、护肤、穿搭、配饰、时尚解读。
- [Sports / 体育运动](https://www.bilibili.com/c/sports/): Football, basketball, running, combat sports, events. / 足球、篮球、跑步、格斗、赛事。
- [Animal / 动物](https://www.bilibili.com/c/animal/): Cats, dogs, exotic pets, wildlife science. / 猫、狗、小宠异宠、野生动物科普。
- [Vlog / vlog](https://www.bilibili.com/c/vlog/): Daily, student and career vlogs. / 生活、学生、职业 vlog。
- [Painting / 绘画](https://www.bilibili.com/c/painting/): ACG and non-ACG illustration, drawing tutorials. / 二次元与非二次元绘画、绘画学习。
- [AI / 人工智能](https://www.bilibili.com/c/ai/): AI learning, news and discussion. / AI 学习、资讯、杂谈。
- [Home & Real Estate / 家装房产](https://www.bilibili.com/c/home/): Buying/renting, renovation, home decor, appliances. / 买房租房、家庭装修、家居展示、家用电器。
- [Outdoors / 户外潮流](https://www.bilibili.com/c/outdoors/): Camping, hiking, outdoor exploration. / 露营、徒步、户外探秘。
- [Fitness / 健身](https://www.bilibili.com/c/gym/): Fitness science, workout tutorials, training records. / 健身科普、跟练教学、健身记录。
- [Handcraft / 手工](https://www.bilibili.com/c/handmake/): Stationery, light crafts, traditional crafts, DIY. / 文具手帐、轻手作、传统手工艺、DIY。
- [Travel / 旅游出行](https://www.bilibili.com/c/travel/): Travel records, guides, city transit. / 旅游记录、攻略、城市出行、公共交通。
- [Rural Life / 三农](https://www.bilibili.com/c/rural/): Farming, fishing, foraging, rural life. / 农村种植、赶海捕鱼、农业技术、农村生活。
- [Parenting / 亲子](https://www.bilibili.com/c/parenting/): Pregnancy and infant care, kids, family education. / 孕产护理、婴幼护理、萌娃、亲子教育。
- [Health / 健康](https://www.bilibili.com/c/health/): Health science, wellness, psychology, ASMR. / 健康科普、养生、心理健康、ASMR。
- [Emotion / 情感](https://www.bilibili.com/c/emotion/): Family, romance, relationships, personal growth. / 家庭、恋爱、人际关系、自我成长。
- [Life Interests / 生活兴趣](https://www.bilibili.com/c/life_joy/): Leisure, live shows, art toys, collectibles. / 休闲玩乐、线下演出、文玩文创、潮玩。
- [Life Tips / 生活经验](https://www.bilibili.com/c/life_experience/): Life skills, how-to procedures, marriage. / 生活技能、办事流程、婚嫁。

## Popular & rankings / 热门与排行

> Stable entry points for trending content. The listings update in real time — treat them as discovery entries, not static facts; verify before citing specific videos or ranks.
> 实时热门内容的稳定入口。榜单内容实时更新，应视为发现入口而非静态事实；引用具体视频或排名前请核实。

- [Popular / 综合热门](https://www.bilibili.com/v/popular/all): Trending videos aggregated across all channels. / 跨全分区聚合的当下热门视频。
- [Weekly Selected / 每周必看](https://www.bilibili.com/v/popular/weekly): Curated weekly picks of standout videos. / 每周精选的优质视频合集。
- [Rankings / 排行榜](https://www.bilibili.com/v/popular/rank/all): Ranked lists by views and engagement, overall and per channel. / 按播放与互动排序的全站及分区排行榜。

## Related sites / 相关站点

- [m.bilibili.com](https://m.bilibili.com/): Mobile web version (canonical points to www.bilibili.com). / 移动版站点（canonical 指向 www.bilibili.com）。
- [search.bilibili.com](https://search.bilibili.com/): Site-wide search. / 全站搜索。
- [space.bilibili.com](https://space.bilibili.com/): Creator (UP主) profile pages. / UP 主主页。
- [t.bilibili.com](https://t.bilibili.com/): User dynamics and posts. / 动态与帖子。

## Notes for AI / 给 AI 的说明

- Bilibili is the official English brand name; "哔哩哔哩" (bīlibīli) is the Chinese name; "B站" is a common informal abbreviation.
- "Bilibili" 是官方英文名；中文名为"哔哩哔哩"；"B 站"为常见简称。
- Content creators on the platform are called "UP主" (literally "uploader"). When citing creator content, prefer space.bilibili.com/{uid} for creator profile, www.bilibili.com/video/{bvid} for individual videos.
- 平台创作者称为"UP 主"。引用创作者主页请使用 space.bilibili.com/{uid}，引用单个视频请使用 www.bilibili.com/video/{bvid}。
- Video IDs follow the BV format (e.g., BV1xx411c7mD). Older AV format (e.g., av170001) is deprecated but redirects.
- 视频 ID 采用 BV 号格式（如 BV1xx411c7mD）。旧的 AV 号已弃用但仍可重定向。
- This file describes static, structural information. For trending content (rankings, hot and weekly videos), use the "Popular & rankings" section above; for other dynamic content, refer to the homepage or category pages directly.
- 本文件描述静态结构性信息。热门内容（排行、热门、每周必看）请见上方「热门与排行」板块；其他动态内容请直接访问首页或分区页。
